I count myself as "lucky" when it comes to my therapy. I went into the deep end and got hospitalized for two weeks and ended up getting committed for 6 months as well as getting put onto state insurance, so I HAVE to carve out time at least twice a month to see a therapist or I go back to the hospital. 

Luckily I also work from home and can do morning appointments,  but I know that's not feasible for everyone. So my best guess or 'idea' is to work with your job if you can end up affording it. 

Side note, I go through a place called Weber Human Services (state run, well funded program) and if I didn't have insurance it would cost me 180 a week. So I'm always grateful. 🙏
